Write a data frame to a SAS XPORT (.xpt) file

Source: R/xpt_rw.r
ks_write_xpt.Rd

Writes a data frame to a SAS XPORT V5 or V8 file using a built-in C++ writer. Variable labels and SAS formats are taken from per-column attributes (`"label"`, `"format.sas"`) or the optional `labels` / `formats` arguments, which override attributes.

Usage

ks_write_xpt(
  data,
  file,
  version = 5L,
  convert_dates = TRUE,
  dataset_name = NULL,
  dataset_label = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  formats = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

file

Output path.

version

Integer 5 or 8. Default `5L` (widest compatibility).

convert_dates

Logical. If `TRUE` (default), `Date` and `POSIXct` columns are converted to SAS numeric (days / seconds since 1960-01-01).

dataset_name

SAS dataset name. Up to 8 characters for V5, up to 32 for V8. Defaults to `"DATASET"`.

dataset_label

Up to 40 characters describing the dataset.

labels

Optional named character vector of variable labels keyed by column name. Overrides per-column `"label"` attributes.

formats

Optional named character vector of SAS formats (e.g. `"DATE9."`, `"F8.2"`) keyed by column name. Overrides per-column `"format.sas"` attributes.

Value

The output file path, invisibly.

Details

Date and datetime conversion, when enabled, applies the R-to-SAS epoch shift to columns of class `Date` or `POSIXct`.

See also

[ks_read_xpt()]
